Strategy: Score is the absolute distance in log space between the leftover plus one and 26, so the preferred leftover is near 25 with differences compressed for large residuals. It differs from Best Fit whenever the tightest leftover is far from 25. It may help by treating large residual differences as less important, or fail because the logarithmic scale may under-penalize very loose bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-abs(log(1 + abs(r - item)) - log(26)) for r in bins]
```
